answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil resistance arises from a stake-weighted spiral ascent. Each agent must deposit escalating collateral that traces a ridge of successive verification rounds; only those who reach the summit of continuous re-staking earn full attestation rights. An attacker forging many identities must replicate the entire spiral for every fake, multiplying capital lock-up and opportunity cost until the cumulative ridge becomes economically prohibitive.
